record.name: Animal Holding Facility
record.description: The Animal Holding Facility was built in phases starting in 1990. It was constructed to meet the need for more space to hold dogs for research. Phase II of construction was completed in 1994 and Phase III was completed in 2001.

interpretation: The public Purdue historic record confirms identity and phased construction but its image_url is null. This record does not provide exterior photographs, elevations, or facade details.
